record.question: Factor of Safety (FOS) of a slope when there is a tension crack and water pressure present is:
options: FOS= c. A+(W. Cosβ -V)tanφ / W. Sinβ+U
FOS= c. A+(W. Cosβ +V)tanφ / W. Sinβ - U
FOS= c. A+(W. Sinβ -V)tanφ / W. Cosβ + U
FOS= c. A+(W. Sinβ +V)tanφ / W. Cosβ - U
record.explanation: The FOS formula with tension crack and water pressure is cA+(W cosβ - V)tanφ over W sinβ + U.
